name: Death Of A Friend
overview: The death of a friend is a deeply sorrowful experience, yet Scripture assures believers that the Lord is near to the brokenhearted and saves those with a contrite spirit (Psalms 34:18). God values the death of His saints as precious (Psalms 116:15), and through faith in Jesus Christ—who is the resurrection and the life—believers have the hope of eternal life beyond physical death (John 11:25; John 3:16). This hope is grounded in the new birth that enables one to see the kingdom of God (John 3:3), providing comfort and assurance amid grief, as the Lord shepherds His people and meets their deepest needs (Psalms 23:1).
